<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_ComputerRepair"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/computer-repair">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_DefectiveComputer" name="Defective computer"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_RepairCostCalculation" name="Repair cost calculation"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_AcceptDecision" name="Accept repair costs"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_RejectDecision" name="Reject repair costs"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_ComputerRepair">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer" processRef="Process_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_CRS" name="CRS" processRef="Process_CRS"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Computer" name="Brings in defective computer" sourceRef="Task_BringComputer" targetRef="Start_ComputerReceived" messageRef="Message_DefectiveComputer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_CostCalculation" name="Repair cost calculation" sourceRef="Task_SendCostCalculation" targetRef="Task_ReceiveCostCalculation" messageRef="Message_RepairCostCalculation"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Accept" name="Accept repair costs" sourceRef="Task_SendAcceptance" targetRef="Task_ReceiveAcceptance" messageRef="Message_AcceptDecision"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Reject" name="Reject repair costs" sourceRef="Task_SendRejection" targetRef="Task_ReceiveRejection" messageRef="Message_RejectDecision"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Customer" name="Customer repair request" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Customer" name="Defective computer needs repair"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_BringComputer" name="Bring in defective computer" messageRef="Message_DefectiveComputer"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveCostCalculation" name="Receive repair cost calculation" messageRef="Message_RepairCostCalculation"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AcceptCosts" name="Are the costs acceptable?"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendAcceptance" name="Send acceptance" messageRef="Message_AcceptDecision"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_CustomerAccept" name="Repair accepted"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendRejection" name="Send rejection" messageRef="Message_RejectDecision"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_TakeComputerHome" name="Take computer home unrepaired"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_CustomerReject" name="Computer taken home unrepaired"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_1" sourceRef="Start_Customer" targetRef="Task_BringComputer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_2" sourceRef="Task_BringComputer" targetRef="Task_ReceiveCostCalculation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_3" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveCostCalculation" targetRef="Gateway_AcceptCosts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_Accept" name="Costs acceptable" sourceRef="Gateway_AcceptCosts" targetRef="Task_SendAcceptance">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">costsAcceptable</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_Reject" name="Costs not acceptable" sourceRef="Gateway_AcceptCosts" targetRef="Task_SendRejection">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">not costsAcceptable</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_4" sourceRef="Task_SendAcceptance" targetRef="End_CustomerAccept"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_5" sourceRef="Task_SendRejection" targetRef="Task_TakeComputerHome"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_6" sourceRef="Task_TakeComputerHome" targetRef="End_CustomerReject"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_CRS" name="CRS computer repair" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_ComputerReceived" name="Defective computer received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_ComputerReceived" messageRef="Message_DefectiveComputer"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckDefect" name="Check defect"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareCostCalculation" name="Prepare repair cost calculation"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendCostCalculation" name="Hand out repair cost calculation" messageRef="Message_RepairCostCalculation"/>
    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="Gateway_WaitForDecision" name="Wait for customer decision" eventGatewayType="Exclusive"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveAcceptance" name="Receive acceptance" messageRef="Message_AcceptDecision"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveRejection" name="Receive rejection" messageRef="Message_RejectDecision"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RepairOrder" name="Choose repair order"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_HardwareFirst" name="Check and repair hardware"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_TestAfterHardwareFirst" name="Test system functionality after hardware repair"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ErrorAfterHardwareFirst" name="Error detected after hardware repair?"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RepairAfterHardwareError" name="Perform another repair activity"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RetestAfterHardwareError" name="Test system functionality"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RetestHardwareError" name="Error detected?"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SoftwareSecond" name="Check and configure software"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_TestAfterSoftwareSecond" name="Test system functionality after software configuration"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ErrorAfterSoftwareSecond" name="Error detected after software configuration?"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RepairAfterSoftwareError" name="Perform another repair activity"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RetestAfterSoftwareError" name="Test system functionality"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RetestSoftwareError" name="Error detected?"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SoftwareFirst" name="Check and configure software"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_TestAfterSoftwareFirst" name="Test system functionality after software configuration"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ErrorAfterSoftwareFirst" name="Error detected after software configuration?"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RepairAfterSoftwareFirstError" name="Perform another repair activity"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RetestAfterSoftwareFirstError" name="Test system functionality"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RetestSoftwareFirstError" name="Error detected?"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_HardwareSecond" name="Check and repair hardware"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_TestAfterHardwareSecond" name="Test system functionality after hardware repair"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ErrorAfterHardwareSecond" name="Error detected after hardware repair?"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RepairAfterHardwareSecondError" name="Perform another repair activity"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RetestAfterHardwareSecondError" name="Test system functionality"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RetestHardwareSecondError" name="Error detected?"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_RepairFinished" name="Repair finished"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_RepairDeclined" name="Repair not undertaken"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CRS_1" sourceRef="Start_ComputerReceived" targetRef="Task_CheckDefect"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CRS_2" sourceRef="Task_CheckDefect" targetRef="Task_PrepareCostCalculation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CRS_3" sourceRef="Task_PrepareCostCalculation" targetRef="Task_SendCostCalculation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CRS_4" sourceRef="Task_SendCostCalculation" targetRef="Gateway_WaitForDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CRS_Accept" sourceRef="Gateway_WaitForDecision" targetRef="Task_ReceiveAcceptance"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CRS_Reject" sourceRef="Gateway_WaitForDecision" targetRef="Task_ReceiveRejection"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CRS_5" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveAcceptance" targetRef="Gateway_RepairOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CRS_6" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveRejection" targetRef="End_RepairDeclined"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Order_HardwareFirst" name="Hardware first" sourceRef="Gateway_RepairOrder" targetRef="Task_HardwareFirst"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Order_SoftwareFirst" name="Software first" sourceRef="Gateway_RepairOrder" targetRef="Task_SoftwareFirst"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_HF_1" sourceRef="Task_HardwareFirst" targetRef="Task_TestAfterHardwareFirst"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_HF_2" sourceRef="Task_TestAfterHardwareFirst" targetRef="Gateway_ErrorAfterHardwareFirst"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_HF_Error" name="Error detected" sourceRef="Gateway_ErrorAfterHardwareFirst" targetRef="Task_RepairAfterHardwareError">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">errorDetected</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_HF_NoError" name="No error" sourceRef="Gateway_ErrorAfterHardwareFirst" targetRef="Task_SoftwareSecond">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">not errorDetected</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_HF_3" sourceRef="Task_RepairAfterHardwareError" targetRef="Task_RetestAfterHardwareError"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_HF_4" sourceRef="Task_RetestAfterHardwareError" targetRef="Gateway_RetestHardwareError"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_HF_RetryError" name="Error detected" sourceRef="Gateway_RetestHardwareError" targetRef="Task_RepairAfterHardwareError">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">errorDetected</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_HF_RetryDone" name="No error" sourceRef="Gateway_RetestHardwareError" targetRef="Task_SoftwareSecond">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">not errorDetected</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_HF_5" sourceRef="Task_SoftwareSecond" targetRef="Task_TestAfterSoftwareSecond"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_HF_6" sourceRef="Task_TestAfterSoftwareSecond" targetRef="Gateway_ErrorAfterSoftwareSecond"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_HF_SoftwareError" name="Error detected" sourceRef="Gateway_ErrorAfterSoftwareSecond" targetRef="Task_RepairAfterSoftwareError">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">errorDetected</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_HF_SoftwareNoError" name="No error" sourceRef="Gateway_ErrorAfterSoftwareSecond" targetRef="End_RepairFinished">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">not errorDetected</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_HF_7" sourceRef="Task_RepairAfterSoftwareError" targetRef="Task_RetestAfterSoftwareError"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_HF_8" sourceRef="Task_RetestAfterSoftwareError" targetRef="Gateway_RetestSoftwareError"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_HF_SoftwareRetryError" name="Error detected" sourceRef="Gateway_RetestSoftwareError" targetRef="Task_RepairAfterSoftwareError">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">errorDetected</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_HF_SoftwareRetryDone" name="No error" sourceRef="Gateway_RetestSoftwareError" targetRef="End_RepairFinished">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">not errorDetected</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SF_1" sourceRef="Task_SoftwareFirst" targetRef="Task_TestAfterSoftwareFirst"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SF_2" sourceRef="Task_TestAfterSoftwareFirst" targetRef="Gateway_ErrorAfterSoftwareFirst"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SF_Error" name="Error detected" sourceRef="Gateway_ErrorAfterSoftwareFirst" targetRef="Task_RepairAfterSoftwareFirstError">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">errorDetected</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SF_NoError" name="No error" sourceRef="Gateway_ErrorAfterSoftwareFirst" targetRef="Task_HardwareSecond">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">not errorDetected</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SF_3" sourceRef="Task_RepairAfterSoftwareFirstError" targetRef="Task_RetestAfterSoftwareFirstError"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SF_4" sourceRef="Task_RetestAfterSoftwareFirstError" targetRef="Gateway_RetestSoftwareFirstError"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SF_RetryError" name="Error detected" sourceRef="Gateway_RetestSoftwareFirstError" targetRef="Task_RepairAfterSoftwareFirstError">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">errorDetected</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SF_RetryDone" name="No error" sourceRef="Gateway_RetestSoftwareFirstError" targetRef="Task_HardwareSecond">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">not errorDetected</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SF_5" sourceRef="Task_HardwareSecond" targetRef="Task_TestAfterHardwareSecond"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SF_6" sourceRef="Task_TestAfterHardwareSecond" targetRef="Gateway_ErrorAfterHardwareSecond"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SF_HardwareError" name="Error detected" sourceRef="Gateway_ErrorAfterHardwareSecond" targetRef="Task_RepairAfterHardwareSecondError">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">errorDetected</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SF_HardwareNoError" name="No error" sourceRef="Gateway_ErrorAfterHardwareSecond" targetRef="End_RepairFinished">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">not errorDetected</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SF_7" sourceRef="Task_RepairAfterHardwareSecondError" targetRef="Task_RetestAfterHardwareSecondError"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SF_8" sourceRef="Task_RetestAfterHardwareSecondError" targetRef="Gateway_RetestHardwareSecondError"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SF_HardwareRetryError" name="Error detected" sourceRef="Gateway_RetestHardwareSecondError" targetRef="Task_RepairAfterHardwareSecondError">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">errorDetected</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SF_HardwareRetryDone" name="No error" sourceRef="Gateway_RetestHardwareSecondError" targetRef="End_RepairFinished">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">not errorDetected</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
